question: Under fixed supplied detections, when do current baseline and timing rules recover analytic optical measurements, report unavailability, or differ from the explicitly imposed signal component?
scope: BOI, both signs separately. Deterministic synthetic development evidence only. No detector, tissue eligibility, cohort read, parameter tuning, baseline replacement or physiological validation.
standing_requirements: Biological variability is not represented by these few deterministic recipes; this is a measurement challenge, not R3 completion.
Physiological onset/recovery, oxygen calibration and scientific outcome admission remain unresolved.
Use current MATLAB implementation and reusable source audit; export readable results, recipe IDs, source traces, exact settings and code hashes.
Preserve earlier changes and evidence, including failed attempts.
Use 1 Hz frame intervals; exposure and embedded timestamps are not a timing source.
amplitude_reference: The imposed component is additive relative to the declared 100-unit background reference. ImposedFixedFootprintPeakFraction averages that component over the fixed native union before the signed extremum and division by 100. ImposedActivePixelPeakFraction is the local imposed peak / 100. Neither is absolute oxygen or automatically the estimand of the current pre-event-baseline measurement.
default_recipe: 100-unit raw background, selected pixel 1, native and measurement frames 41:45, signed 20-unit pulse, no other masks. Each listed recipe changes only named ingredients.

budget: One execution of these fixed cases and existing relevant tests; correct harness errors only if required, preserving attempts. No sweeps, extra recordings, or parameter changes. Stop and report production disagreement rather than silently change expectations.
stopping_decision: Retain current rules if arithmetic passes; restrict claims where reference/support differ; defer scientific baseline/timing policy. No scientific acceptance threshold is adopted.
comparison_priority: Researcher preference remains pending; this shared measurement task is independent of comparison choice.

outcome: Retain current calculations and all selected results; restrict reference/support and physiological timing claims; defer scientific policy.
